organization.summary: Daily Ethereum news newsletter and podcast. Its Advertise page calls it a news briefing since 2022 and reports 4,000+ newsletter subscribers, 6,000+ audio subscribers and 26,000+ combined social followers (self-published).

claims.method: The Advertise page states 6,000+ audio subscribers, 4,000+ newsletter subscribers and 26,000+ combined social followers. Not verified: user, request and subscriber counts come from the applicant's own pages; no independent public source was found.

claims.method: The Advertise page says the briefing runs 'since 2022'. Four years from 2022 reaches 2026. Continuity was not checked.
